name: JTBD2 — Failed extract-refresh jobs via list-jobs
description: Job-performance JTBD via the REST list-jobs path. Requires ADMIN_TOOLS_ENABLED=true and site-admin PAT. Model should filter list-jobs on jobType (refresh_extracts) and status (Failed) to find failed extract-refresh jobs. On the test site all tasks are healthy, so an empty/no-failures result is correct. Read-only.
prompt: Are there any failed extract-refresh jobs on this site? Use the list-jobs tool filtered to extract-refresh job type and Failed status. Report any failures found, or state clearly that there are none. Do not modify anything.
